title: Plan
description: Frontmatter schema for downstream-project plan files (per spec §3.3). Consumed by /plan-spec --quick to validate plan-frontmatter at authoring time.

project.description: Project identifier the plan belongs to.

created.description: ISO 8601 date the plan was created.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the plan's last update.

supersedes.description: Identifiers of prior plans this plan supersedes.

promotes-to.description: Identifiers of downstream artifacts (typically ADRs) this plan promotes to on convergence.
